messages:
nidhi: Heads-up — premerge CI for PR #7312 threw a mixed SAST/DAST result. SAST flagged use of keystore.Decrypt in a new auth helper, DAST found an unauthenticated GET on /health-check that returns a rendered secret snippet. Artifact: gs://ci/7312/scan.json

cory: ouch. paste the snippets?

nidhi: 
```
SAST: auth/helper.go:54 keystore.Decrypt(userSuppliedKey) -> potential secret exfil
DAST: GET /health-check -> response body includes 'config: <redacted>' but shows partial decrypted value
```

alexa: tagging @paul (platform) — any RBAC/KMS flips this week?

paul: we rolled an RBAC tightening Monday (svc-monitor lost read-only to keystore). Also applied a staging KMS key rotation on Tue. Why suspect that?

nidhi: SAST points at code path that only runs when service account can call Decrypt; DAST shows health-check exposing a config value when the agent has decrypt rights. Seems like a permission mismatch between service identity and runtime.

oncall-sre: I can repro in staging. If the monitor SA got elevated during rotation window, it could explain transient exposure. I'll capture keystore audit slice.

security-bot: Scan summary: 1 HIGH (possible secret exposure), 5 MED. Triage suggested: assign owner, reproduce, attach KMS audit logs, confirm false positive vs regression.

cory: I'll own SAST triage. Will grep for keystore.Decrypt usage and add unit tests. alexa, can you coordinate DAST repro?

alexa: yes. oncall-sre, prefer a 15m repro window now or later?

oncall-sre: now works. opening ephemeral grant for monitor-sa and recording in keystore-change log.

paul: attached audit log to ticket SEC-9502 (created). Note: the RBAC change revoked monitor read; rotation created a short-lived grant for rollout which may have been scoped too broadly.

cory: quick code excerpt added to SEC-9502; helper incorrectly defaults to env-provided key when userKey empty. Fix: fail closed, do not call Decrypt on health-check path. Opening PR WIP.

alexa: DAST repro confirms health-check leaked partial decrypted config only when monitor-sa had decrypt. When revoked, response sanitizes. Logged proof in SEC-9502.

oncall-sre: ephemeral grant ended; audit has key id + requestor.

nidhi: actions in SEC-9502: cory->SAST fix and unit tests, alexa->DAST verify no leakage, paul->tighten ephemeral grant scope & update keystore-change playbook, oncall-sre->attach audit proof. ETA EOD.

security-bot: Reminder: any KMS/RBAC temporary grants must include ticket reference and keystore-change entry.

cory: PR https://github.com/redwood/auth/pull/934 opened (fix: fail closed and add test).

paul: I'll update playbook with explicit least-privilege template for ephemeral grants and note correlation steps between audit entries and CI artifacts.

nidhi: thanks all. Closing Slack thread; will keep SEC-9502 for verification and short blameless postmortem. :white_check_mark:
